chapter: Part Two: theaters and the Chicago scene
title: Chicago's music scene in the twenties
summary: Plenty of jobs; Chicago was as great as New York.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What was the scene like in Chicago in the twenties? There seems to be an awful lot of activity, a lot of good music being played.

Lot of good music, lot of jobs. You had your nightclubs, you had your theaters, even small theaters had five or six pieces in the pit . Like, oh, what the heck is his name? Very, very good piano player had a small orchestra at the Arles Theater (PHONETIC), 47th and Prairie.
Clarence Jones. And there was a lot of recording going on here, too.
Chicago was really sort of a
Musical center then. We was just as great as New York.
